notes: master regulators: NEUROG2, ASCL1, NEUROD1, MYT1L, POU3F2 [Vierbuchen et al. 2010 (Ascl1/Brn2/Myt1l convert fibroblasts to neurons); Zhang et al. 2013 (NGN2 alone converts stem cells to neurons in days)]
essential = Hart et al. 2017, G3 7:2719 (CEGv2: 684 core-essential genes from CRISPR screens)
core = union of the 13 core libraries (data-driven GO/Reactome membership): what all cells use, a superset of what they strictly need
identity = chosen blueprint/systems libraries minus core; minimal = essential + identity + masters
a eukaryotic cell also needs parts the genome does not encode as genes: rRNA/tRNA arrays, centromeres, telomeres, replication origins, and the maternal machinery of the first cell
